featured_reviews.name: Asmita Bhat
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Yui Asian Diner and had a really good experience overall. We tried the chicken Thai spring rolls, chicken chilli oil dumplings, prawn tempura sushi, and red Thai curry with jasmine rice.
The food was flavorful and well-prepared—especially the dumplings and sushi, which really stood out.
The ambience was calm, modern, and gave off nice Asian dining vibes, making it a great place to relax and enjoy your meal. The staff was attentive and quick, which made the experience even smoother.
Overall, a satisfying dining experience with good food, pleasant ambience, and efficient service. Definitely worth visiting if you’re craving Asian cuisine in Borivali West

Here, i tried their:-
1. Pulled chicken teriyaki sushi 🍣🥢
2. Crunchy California roll 🍣🥢
3. Thai basil chilli dimsums, and 🥟🥢

The taste and quantity justified the price, so it was overall a good experience, and i'd visit here again to try their other items too :)

featured_reviews.name: Prem Nayak
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried Chotu’s in Borivali for a quick Chinese fix. Had manchow soup, schezwan lollipop dry, veg schezwan fried rice and chicken Singapore noodles.
Service was very quick and the quantity of both rice and noodles was quite good.
Typical roadside Chinese taste.
The lollipop was a bit on the chewy side but still decent. Manchow soup had a little too much vinegar and soy sauce for my liking. Veg schezwan fried rice was actually really good and something I’d definitely recommend.
One thing to note is the amount of food colour used- definitely not for someone looking for healthy food. Seating is available outside in the compound with around 9 tables and another 6-7 tables inside.
Considering the street-style setup, quick service and low prices, it’s value for money

featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Had a great experience at Sizzling Spices in Dahisar West! The food was absolutely delicious — especially the Kurkure Momos, Korean Wings, and Osaka Ramen. The chicken was juicy and full of flavour. I also loved that they don’t use MSG, ajinomoto, or food colour, so the food felt clean and light. Portions are generous, staff is friendly, and service was smooth. Definitely a hidden gem for Asian food lovers. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Sizzling Spices in Dahisar with my friends this weekend, and it turned out to be a delightful experience for Asian food lovers. The place is small but cozy, with quick and humble service that makes you feel welcome.

We began with the Chicken Eight Treasure Soup, which was packed with a variety of vegetables along with chicken – light, healthy, and a good start. Next came the Korean-style Crispy Chicken, essentially chicken katsu paired with honey chilli sauce. While the sauce was average, the katsu itself was perfectly crispy and enjoyable.

The highlight of the evening was undoubtedly the Chicken Thai Green Curry Pot Rice. Aromatic, rich in flavor, and served in a portion easily sufficient for three, it stood out as the star dish.

Overall, Sizzling Spices is a nice spot if you’re in the mood for hearty and flavorful Asian cuisine. Definitely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Danny Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently placed an order from Sizzling Spices, and the highlight of my meal was undeniably the Chicken Thai Pot Rice. This dish is a true testament to the restaurant's dedication to delivering authentic Thai flavors in a sizzling and satisfying way.
The presentation of the Chicken Thai Pot Rice was visually appealing, served in a sizzling hot pot. The aroma alone was enough to make my mouth water. The dish featured tender pieces of chicken, perfectly cooked and seasoned to perfection, accompanied by a generous serving of rice.
The Thai spices were expertly balanced, offering a delightful combination of sweet, sour, and spicy notes. Fresh herbs and vegetables added a refreshing crunch to each bite, while the fragrant lemongrass and coconut milk infused the dish with an authentic Thai essence.The portion size was generous, making it ideal for sharing or savoring as a satisfying meal. The sizzling pot kept the dish warm throughout the meal, ensuring that every bite was as enjoyable as the first.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Powale
featured_reviews.review_text:

The food is almost always delicious, there might be some hit or miss dishes but overall good food.
If you dine in, the service is really good  and the food plating and it's presentation is great!
The delivery service is good as well.
The restaurant and it's ambience itself is decent.
And the food is reasonably priced which is a big big plus.

My only real inconvenience was when some customers ordered double servings of brownie ice cream with sizzling chocolate.. Even tho it smelt and looked amazing, double serving basically filled the restaurant with smoke.

So all in all its always a good experience having food from or at Sizzling spice. Try it out!

featured_reviews.review_text: Nischita Hotel holds a special place in my heart, as I've been coming here since childhood. It's a budget-friendly spot ideal for family and friends to enjoy dinner. The food quality is top-notch, but the staff can be a bit inattentive at times, possibly due to being busy with other tasks. The only downside is the challenging parking situation. featured_reviews.review_text: It's roadside Chinese food in an indoor setting. If you like that, you'll like this place. The food color was hard to take off the fingers. The quantity is good.

featured_reviews.name: Aaron Noel D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text: Food is good, especially the tawa items but they tend to use too much oil, and also the mutton kheema tends to have pieces of bones in it. As per the owner, this is because the meat is now procured from vendors who use machines to grind the meat unlike manually before. They also tend to cook their dishes to an extreme spice level which can easily burn your insides! Simple dishes like a Thai green curry or even a Chicken Tandoori full that I ordered were mindblowingly spicy for anyone's liking. Also please don't forget to order directly from the restaurant if you live in IC colony else they heavily overcharge on Zomato/Swiggy. Chicken boti is a recommended dish. In the photo is Chicken Boneless Boti (half) with pav.

featured_reviews.name: rohan dharne
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the worst restaurants to order Chicken Biryani from especially if you are ordering from Zomato. I don’t know if they deliberately serve you bad quality food as you ordered from Zomato or what. This happened now twice. I called them before ordering & made sure how many chicken “pieces” they put it in chicken biryani and their reply was 6. I ordered it and all I got were small chicken bones, hardly any meat on it. I thought maybe because I ordered at late night just 5 mins before restaurant was closing that’s why I got leftover Chicken Biryani but nonetheless I complained to Zomato though they don’t take food quality guarantees anymore still they gave me ₹66 refund coupon which can be exclusively redeemed if order from Nischita Nxt. So I ordered 2nd time via zomato, this time in afternoon & they again serve me bones. I had to squeeze the bones to get some meat. I think it is just 1 chicken leg pieces cut into 6 tiny pieces. It’s a ₹350 priced biryani, even roadside ₹100 biryani have more meat. Terrible experience. I checked their delivery reviews by other users & they had same experience of chickenless biryani though dine-in reviews were appreciating Chicken Biryani.

featured_reviews.name: aditya sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best places to have chinese food here in Borivali, Mumbai. Very simple interior, cozy atmosphere and quality of food really amazing. We had the pork chilli, soup and Shanghai rice which were really tasty. Must visit once.

featured_reviews.name: Niki
featured_reviews.review_text: Authentic Chinese food. Must visit. The staff is really good. The food is amazing. My go to place for Chinese. They offer pork dishes too which is delicious. The atmosphere of the place is really nice less chaotic.

featured_reviews.name: Charmi Anmol Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re focusing on the vegetarian food and ambiance, you could post something like:

Had a wonderful dining experience at Choi Kim Cuisine in IC Colony. The vegetarian food was fresh, flavorful, and prepared perfectly. The dishes had authentic Indo-Chinese flavors without being overly greasy, and the portion sizes were generous.

The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, with a charming Chinese-inspired décor that creates a pleasant dining atmosphere. It’s a great place to enjoy a relaxed meal with family or friends. The service was courteous, and the overall experience was enjoyable. Definitely recommended for anyone looking for good vegetarian Chinese food in Borivali!

The restaurant is often praised for its Chinese-themed interiors and comfortable atmosphere, while many diners mention the quality and consistency of the food.

Never miss Hakka tofu soup for veg lovers

featured_reviews.name: Himani's CC (Brand Marketing Agency)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choi Kim Cuisine served us a good meal with enjoyable flavors, though I felt some of the dishes were more like regular Chinese food rather than something that truly stands out as “cuisine.” Still, the overall experience was positive, and we appreciated the variety on the menu.

The real highlight was the service the staff were very cooperative, attentive, and sweet-spoken, which made the dining atmosphere warm and welcoming.

featured_reviews.name: Rachna Vasandi
featured_reviews.review_text: Whenever I do visit India this is my go to spot for that perfect dose of desi Chinese. Nothing so far has changed the same taste delivered even after years. They serve quick, super hot and fresh. Absolutely lovely authentic mumbai wala Chinese.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Chinese restaurant stands out from the rest - the food is incredibly delicious and uniquely flavored! It's definitely worth trying at least once.
In regards to price it’s in mid range.
The seating arrangement is quite cozy , with tables and chairs placed closely together.

featured_reviews.name: kamlesh kotenkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Legacy restaurant in IC colony that serves since great Chinese food straight up. While I have eaten on several occasions, the reviews is late. Visited recently and had the chicken lollipop oil fry, Chicken Soup, Honey Glazed potato and Okra, Veg Chopsuey. All were great. The tables are very close and it's not a restaurant with a lot of space. Service is fast too.

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Bhatkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Tasty chinese food joint in IC colony with great ambience and cozy seating. Ac seating is always crowded even on weekdays. chicken lollypop and burnt garlic rie were tasty. Good taste although lot of red color and baking soda in food. Good place for cozy budget friendly chinese craving.

featured_reviews.name: Anshita Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Yo Mama recently and really loved the overall experience. The location is very convenient — near Dahisar RTO and just a 2-minute walk from Kandarpada Metro Station.
The ambience is simple and comfortable, perfect for a relaxed meal. What stood out for me is that they make their burger patties fresh in-house, no frozen or readymade stuff, which clearly reflects in the taste.
We started with the Strawberry Boba Tea, which was refreshing. The Buttermilk Hot Chicken Burger was extremely loaded and juicy. Also tried the Kurkura Paneer Wrap, Corn & Cheese Momos (very cheesy), Dan Dan Noodles which were full of flavour, and the Thalassery Chicken Biryani served with tadka raita — definitely worth trying.
Overall, Yo Mama is a great spot for comfort food with good quality and variety including burgers, Chinese, wraps, momos and biryanis. Would definitely recommend checking it out.

featured_reviews.name: Karie LP
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently tried Yo Mama Restaurant and it turned out to be a pretty decent spot. If you’re looking to try a new place that serves Chinese, Thai, biryani, burgers, rolls, and more — this one’s worth checking out.
I ordered:
• Dan Dan Noodles
• Crispy Chicken
• Chicken & Cheese Momos
All the items were good in taste, and the portion sizes were impressive — the noodles and crispy chicken were easily enough for 3 adults. The momos were flavorful and cheesy, just the way they should be.
I also managed to get a 60% discount via Swiggy which made the whole meal total value for money 💯.
Overall, a satisfying experience and a good option if you’re in or around Kandarpada and want variety at reasonable prices.

featured_reviews.name: sheetal patil
featured_reviews.review_text:

Thank you China Panda🐼

featured_reviews.name: shivani shah
featured_reviews.review_text: The food is amazing! Firstly they have all cuisines! The burgers and biryanis were out of this world! The portion size is also large. Korean buns were loaded with souch cheese that just that one bun could fill up the entire stomach- glad we were a group of 6 and so could try out multiple cuisines. We had momos, korean bun, burger, rolls and firni for dessert ( which was perfectly sweet and delicious)

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Saksena
featured_reviews.review_text:
Oh my! How can everything in the menu be so delicious? We had biryani, burger, tandoori thecha paneer, beverages, Chinese and everything was superb! The service was intuitively smart. Very cute and cosy place. Attention to detail by the owners was palpable- the cutlery holder was designed like a vintage radio!

Must haves- Paneer makhni Biryani, buttermilk chicken burger- yum! and the lemon coriander soup that was a bomb! What did I forget? Yes- the phirni!!!! To die for!

Can’t wait to be there again soon!

And yes- very instagrammable photo area as soon as you enter!

Yo Mama! Yo Papa! Yo Youth! Sabke liye superb!

featured_reviews.name: Abby Ruth
featured_reviews.review_text: The food was wonderful and the ambiance also is very inviting. The lemon chicken coriander soup was comforting and had a lot of flavour packed in. We ordered the Dan Dan Chicken noodles as well and the inhouse Dan dan sauce was so yummy. The Thai Chicken starter also was superb. The peach boba tea was cold and made for a refreshing, fun and comforting drink with the meal. A definite 5/5 for this one. Must try!

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Mewada
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Sanjhi for the first time and honestly, I was surprised by the variety they have! It's a pure veg/Jain restaurant which is hard to find for Chinese food lovers. The place has a proper Chinatown vibe with red lanterns and decor . We were greeted with that complimentary crispy noodles & schezwan chutney while waiting – nice touch .

We ordered Manchow soup (absolute must-try) and Triple Schezwan Rice – both were delicious and the quantity is good . The service was quick. Definitely coming back next time with friends to try their sizzlers and sizzling brownie which everyone keeps recommending .

Great atmosphere, pocket-friendly, and perfect for family or friends . Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality veg Chinese in Dahisar!

Tip: Go on a weekday if possible – weekends get quite crowded !

featured_reviews.review_text: This is an 20+ years old Chinese restaurant at Dahisar East.. We had been to this place multiple times and the thing that has not changed is their taste.. They have two sections i.e. AC and Non AC section.. Food is delicious.. Must try items are Manchurian dry, Pot Rice and Veg Noodles.. featured_reviews.name: Jiten Davda
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been dining here since Day 1 of its opening since i stay around.

However over the years the quality of the food has degraded. Expanding their menu and introducing variety of other cuisine had impacted the taste of the Chinese dishes.

Had ordered fried rice and it felt like sticky rice and tasteless.
The hong kong rice had too much of spices which ruined the actual taste.

They are overwhelmed by the demands and unable to cater to everyone on time. Hence no more focus on customer service.

What disappointed me the most is if you ask for regular drinking water. They have only chilled water which is purified, if you want a regular room temperature water, you have to pay for a bottled water.

When i highlighted this issue to the manager he casually said “sab jagah aisa hi hota hai”

Hence, do no fall for the hype anymore.

THEY ACCEPT ONLY CASH PAYMENT !!

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Vegetarian Chinese restaurant is in itself such a unique concept. To execute it well, is another challenge. Sanjhi Nails it. It's vegetarian, It offers lots of authentic Chinese cuisine... And it's Budget-friendly! 🤌🏼

The vibe gives you that "Chinese Restaurant" wale feels. Interior of the restaurant is well thought. Lighting is bit dim, making it perfect for a date as well 😉 There's AC sitting as well. Staff is very nice - Menu was explained properly. And the Waiter made sure to cover the serving bowl so that food stays warm 🥹

They even serve Pav Bhaji, Sandwich, etc. Menu is really exhaustive. We ordered Chef's Special Mexican Paneer Starter & Koi Tiow Phad Phak Flat Noodles.

THE STARTER was really tasty, couldn't figure how it was "Mexican" tho. Maybe bcoz it had Basil, Capsicum?! Taste wise it was good. Paneer was soft as expected.

FLAT NOODLES were chewy and great in taste. They use exotic veggies like Broccoli, Red cabbage, Basil, Zucchini etc.

Can't wait to visit again!

featured_reviews.name: RAJENDRA D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tasty Chinese food outlet  is on laxman Mhatre Road and opposite to Shagun restaurant at Dahisar west.

Cosy place where apart from take away only 4 persons seatings is available.

Food rates are affordable & offer takeaway option.
Green chilly offers Veg soup  Veg 🍜, Veg Fried Rice,Veg Gravy ( Manchurian  etc), veg chowing
Non veg Dishes  chicken soup, chicken noodles 🍜, fried rice etc.
Known for above Chinese veg and non veg where  take away option is  available.

featured_reviews.name: Janvi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is just opposite to the Shagun Hotel. We picked up sezwan rice and Dry Manchurian. The prices are decent and regular.

The manchurian was tasty but it was dry and the set back was that it was not cooked from the inside. If only they fried it properly it will be one of their best dishes.

The rice was good maybe add a little more flavour to it.

featured_reviews.name: Jitu Singhaniya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very tasty and spicy 🔥 food and owsm quantity and very low price all Chinese food available in the restaurant . This is located in I. C colony holy cross road boriwali west mumbai maharashtra.
Very quickly and fast service in the restaurant and also fast delivery and free home delivery in around under 3 km . Also all time available in Zomato app and this is very tasty and spicy food. Specialy for chicken chili and chicken soup and chicken fried rice recipe mumbai borivali maharastra

featured_reviews.name: Ved Kulkarni

customer_updates.name: Ashwin Kamat
customer_updates.text: Excellent food. We had chicken quesadilla, chicken tikka nachos, chicken roulade as starters. Nachos are amazing even non-nacho fans loved it. In the main course we had veg Thuppa and mojo criollo chicken steak all amazing. Tiramisu as sweet was excellent. Blushing Caprioska was ok not worth the hype.

featured_reviews.name: Sujit Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: This is our absolute favourite restaurant. We have been going here since years. To celebrate any occasion this is our go to place. The taste here is out of the world. The Fusion Kitchen will have our patronage for years to come. Some of pur favourite dishes are Loaded Nachos, Barbeque wings, Pesto Pasta. Margarita for drinks and to end it Tres Leches for dessert.

featured_reviews.name: Anwesh Goda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Fusion Kitchen today and had a really great experience. The continental food here is absolutely delicious, with every dish prepared perfectly and full of flavor. The ambience adds a lot to the overall vibe—calm, cozy, and perfect for a relaxed meal.
A special mention to Ashish, who was extremely welcoming and attentive. He took our order patiently and ensured everything was served smoothly, making the experience even better.
Overall, a lovely place to enjoy good food and great hospitality. Definitely looking forward to visiting again!

featured_reviews.name: Hillary DSouza
featured_reviews.review_text: The food ordered was not bad however the sequence of service was could have been better, ordered for chicken lemon coriander soup and cheese Garlic bread but the soup was served first and the cheese Garlic bread come much later, we didn't even finish our soup and the main course arrived. Honestly speaking this is not sequence of Service.  Being our Special Day  I did not complain.  Also the Service Charges charged are No Where to the Services rendered.

featured_reviews.name: Ramsha Tausalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Tucked away in the lanes of IC Colony in Borivali is an 11-year old restaurant that is a crowd favourite. The Fusion Kitchen is warm, cozy and their main theme is travel which is reflected in their interiors. Through all these years, their food has stayed consistent in taste and quality. As their name suggests, they do fusion food, but mostly continental. Each dish has a unique presentation and I really enjoyed everything I had. Great for those who like international flavours with a good desi touch. It’s perfect for visiting with both family and friends.

featured_reviews.name: gaurav yerunkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best place for good food and good vibe near kandarpada metro station. This place is small but pretty, ambience is nice, I’ll recommend doing a reservation so u don’t have to wait for table. The staff is very polite and knowledgeable. The food is just awesome. All dishes we tried we just amazing. If you are having a drink go for chicken nachos as sides, I don’t remember the dish names but check the pics and am telling you the dishes taste great just as they look. They have a valet service so you don’t have to worry about parking.just one thing that we didn’t like was the blueberry cheesecake.
Do visit this place

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav sketches
featured_reviews.review_text: The chefs at Fusion kitchen makes a perfect recipe to give you Heart Disease & High Cholesterol. Eating foods from outlets like Fusion can is abuse to your health and Body. Attaching pictures of what was delivered to us in the name of Italian Dish “Aglio olio” dipped in some Cheap refund or Palmolein Oil

featured_reviews.name: Rashmi V
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great dinner at TFK a few days back ! Today I saw the pics I had clicked and it reminded me of the good time and so I am posting this review. I liked thier concept of having a limited menu and so the food was fresh and  service was amazingly fast. The food was delicious and we loved the Tiramisu and ordered it twice :) Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Legendary Kingston
featured_reviews.review_text:
Reached here around 6.30 pm.. Inquired for happy hours but was informed that it ends at 7pm...so placed orders for beer ...had asked to get the beer first , but the beer was deliberately brought late to the table time and again to cross the happy hours. Even the second time on addressing this to the server was informed that the service personnel on the upper floor was new and beer was being dispatched from the dispenser...what rubbish reasoning , we asked for the pint to be brought to the table just like other restaurants do but they were refusing to do so...there were mosquitoes in the resturant which kept on bitting us at the table...there was a hostess at the entrance who was just making faces when we had queries . The food was just fine , nothing that great , the veggies on the chicken had no seasoning but just served for the sake of it...music was being played and stopped a million times...the restroom had a leak issue in the urinal wherein everything was seeping down to the foot from the urinal pipe which was disgusting.
The management has either taken their guest for granted or are not bothered..

featured_reviews.name: ralph sequeira
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wanted to dine here for a long time, finally got the opportunity, so visited with my wife.  Good part is this is a wine and dine restaurant plus you have lot of the coastal and mangalorean and goan and chinese cusine available .

We tried a beer and multiple different starters.

The ambience is very good made for family and friends alike.
The owner plays some good 80s-90s Indian music which is not too loud so you can have a conversation .
The food is very good and the service is fast.
Surely to visit again to try out the dishes I didn't this time.

Only draw back is the pricing is a little on the expensive side, but even if you are price sensitive it is a one time try.

featured_reviews.name: carron Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: I happened to order a full chicken tandoori! And when the chicken came it was mind blowing!! The flavours and spices blended so well together!!. Believe the tandoori chicken you order from here is number 1 compared to other restaurants. The tandoori you may have from other restaurants may disappoint you but this one never!!!

featured_reviews.name: Atharva Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent food. Menu is particularly high standard. Definitely fine dining. It can be little expensive but worth it. I recommend manglorian and Kerala style food you should try. Highly recommended.
Sanjay Debnath was the host and he was very polite and informative, he attended us so well.

featured_reviews.name: Prakash David
featured_reviews.review_text:
Service was slow..may be gas issue..
Food quality was ok.although we ordered chicken dishes but West coast is popular for Fish .
Ambience was good
this is very appropriate for family
n no. of my visit there were decent family crowd
also take away counter and food delivery order are accepted

featured_reviews.name: Ashwini Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chicken biryani was too good. Everybody liked it. Preparation and packaging 💯
All items ordered were fresh and tasty 🤤
Thanks for taking bulk order with short notice

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Karnamkotil
featured_reviews.review_text: Food and liquor rates are very very high. Average ambience. Reminds me of the Bar and Restaurants of the 90s. Very basic look and sitting. Food quality and aste is good. Not an average middle class persons place.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwini Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
A small restaurant setup with congested sitting.
The food was one of the best I have had in restaurants. We had bombil fry, chicken lollipop, cheese corn palak kabab, veg korma, mangalore chicken curry, appam, paratha and neer dosa. Quality food especially nonveg.
Service was good. Dish suggestions were best.
Overall a good experience.

featured_reviews.name: Three Foodiots
featured_reviews.review_text: I used to love ordering from Chopsueys..it was one of my favourite go-to outlets..but lately, the quality has really gone downhill. In my last order, the rice and chicken tasted stale, which was very disappointing. The chicken pieces were rubbery and didn’t feel fresh at all, and shockingly, many of the so-called “chicken pieces” seemed like maida blobs rather than actual meat. On top of that, I’ve noticed that when ordering through Zomato or Swiggy, especially using coupons, both the quality and quantity drop significantly. Overall, this experience has been very disappointing, and it’s sad to see a once-favourite place decline like this.
